title: AOP2 Subsystem Service Hierarchy & Task Topology

running_tasks.name: roottask.IOP_ASC7.RELEASE
running_tasks.role: Master system supervisor; initializes coprocessor hardware, verifies sub-binary signatures, and establishes root IPC channels.

running_tasks.name: AppleFirmwareKit Motion App
running_tasks.role: Manages 6-axis IMU fast-path streaming, TrueTone ambient lux telemetry, and Always-On Display timing.

running_tasks.name: AONLocationApp
running_tasks.role: Pedestrian Dead Reckoning (PDR), step cadence counting, and low-power geofencing.

running_tasks.name: Audio Hotword App
running_tasks.role: Low-power microphone capture, 3.0-second circular SRAM acoustic FIFO, and local Siri keyword detection.

running_tasks.name: RTKit-Exclave Bridge
running_tasks.role: Cross-enclave bridge forwarding sensor privacy status to ExclaveOS via DART SID 0x11 (EP 0x53).

running_tasks.name: AppleSPUFirmwareBuilder Runtime
running_tasks.role: Shared C++ runtime library hosting AppleFirmwareKit base classes, method tables, and memory allocators.

running_tasks.name: RTKit Microkernel Preload
running_tasks.role: EL1 bare-metal microkernel preboot, ARM64 vector tables, and priority-driven preemptive scheduler.

AFKRootService.description: Root service anchoring all AppleFirmwareKit sub-services; manages global lifecycle and power assertion state.

AFKSystemService.description: Handles system-level control commands from host Darwin kernel, including firmware version negotiation and reset.

AFKPowerAssertService.description: Arbitrates low-power retention states and host AP wake assertions.

AFKDTService.description: Parses embedded DeviceTree properties and binds hardware registers to driver objects.

AFKTBDTService.description: Tightbeam RPC DeviceTree Service providing strongly-typed configuration queries.

AFKEPInterfaceServiceV2.description: Manages endpoint interface descriptor tables and asynchronous event queues.

dispatch_queues.name: BackgroundQueue
dispatch_queues.role: Deferred background calculations (step filtering, lux smoothing)

_aop2_shm_reg.purpose: Host-to-coprocessor fast-path circular telemetry ring buffers.

_RTK_EXT_SHD_DTA.purpose: External shared status structures and mailbox descriptor rings.

__CMA.purpose: Contiguous Memory Allocator dedicated logging buffers for location dead reckoning.

sharedmem_xcoproc_AOP2_EP53_in.purpose: Cross-enclave shared memory window directly mapped into ExclaveOS for sensor privacy state.
